title: Ollama native client panics when thinking or text precedes a tool call
observed: internal/provider/ollama/client.go (from #48) ended tool calls with 'for pos := range toolPosOf', ranging over the map's keys (Ollama's tool-call index) as if they were content positions. A reply with thinking or text before a tool call has the call at position >= 1 with index 0, so Content[0].(msg.ToolCall) panics on the unrecovered stream goroutine: 'interface conversion: msg.Content is msg.ThinkingContent, not msg.ToolCall'. An index that is not a content position panics with index out of range (fuzzing found index -3). Most likely cause of the reported crash: the second request of the turn (after the skill result) is where qwen3 thinks before calling a tool; the first reply, a bare tool call, survived only because its index happened to equal its position.
expected: Tool calls are ended by their content position, in content order, whatever precedes them.

fix.note: Range toolPosOf's values, sorted. Reproduced live on origin/main against local Ollama 0.34.0 qwen3:8b with --effort high (panic at client.go:463 on the first request); the fixed build completes the same run. With thinking off qwen3:8b never put text before a tool call in 2 runs, so the user's exact second reply is not reproduced.
